jobs.description:
MedGrocer’s digitally-enabled corporate healthcare solutions empower our customers to get their medicines, vaccines, and teleconsultations conveniently, cost-effectively, and intelligently.

The IT Director is the visionary for MedGrocer’s technological ecosystem. You are responsible for the high-level architecture, data security governance, and digital transformation initiatives that ensure our platform remains the gold standard for patient care.

Why Join MedGrocer?

You will have high-level autonomy to define the company’s technical vision and lead large-scale digital transformations. Your leadership ensures the integrity and reliability of the platform that provides life-saving interventions for patients.

Key Responsibilities
jobs.name: IT Director | Makati
jobs.qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 6-12 years of experience in IT leadership, software architecture, or systems engineering.
  • Expertise in cloud infrastructure, data security standards, and enterprise digital transformation.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing high-performing technical teams.
  • Must work onsite in Makati City.

jobs.description:
Cloud Security Project Engineer (Client-Facing Professional Services)

About the Role

We are looking for a Cloud Security Project Engineer to join our team and support cloud security implementations for enterprise customers in the Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) region.

This is a hands-on technical and client-facing role. You will work with customers, partners, and internal teams to implement, troubleshoot, and support cloud security solutions.

You don't need to be a pure Project Manager. We are looking for someone with a strong background in networking, cloud security, firewalls, proxies, or security technologies who is also comfortable communicating with customers and managing multiple projects.

Experience with Netskope is a strong advantage, but candidates with experience in similar technologies such as Zscaler, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, or other SASE/SSE platforms are welcome to apply.

What You'll Do

Manage multiple customer implementation projects from kickoff to completion.

Work with customers and partners to understand their technical requirements and deployment needs.

Lead or support technical meetings, workshops, and implementation sessions.

Configure, implement, and troubleshoot cloud security solutions.

Work with technologies such as SASE, SSE, SWG, CASB, ZTNA, and DLP.
jobs.name: Cloud Security Project Engineer
jobs.qualifications:
• What We're Looking For

    Technical Experience

    3+ years of experience in one or more of the following:

    Cloud Security

    Network Security

    Network Engineering

    Firewall Administration

    Proxy / Gateway Technologies

    Cybersecurity

    SASE / SSE

    Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Microsoft Azure is an advantage.

    Good understanding of networking concepts such as:

    TCP/IP

    DNS

    Routing

    VPN

    Firewalls

    Security Groups

    Proxy

    SSL/TLS

    Familiarity with SASE/SSE, SWG, CASB, ZTNA, or DLP.

    Experience with IPsec/GRE tunnels, PAC files, traffic steering, or SSL inspection is a plus.

    Netskope experience is highly preferred, but experience with similar security platforms is welcome.

    Project & Customer Skills

    Experience handling customer implementations, technical projects, or client accounts.

    Comfortable managing several tasks or projects at the same time.

    Able to work independently and take ownership of assigned projects.

    Comfortable communicating directly with customers and technical teams.

    Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

    Able to explain technical issues in a simple and clear way.

    Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

    Willing to learn new technologies and processes.
